<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:4:3">Y. Hor. III, 48ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ראש טי׳</he> at the head of the list; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>בראש ט׳</he> Ar. (ed. only <he>בראש</he>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 25:1">Gen. R. s. 25</cite> beg. <he>בתוך טִימוֹסָן וכ׳</he> in the record of the righteous; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 42:2">Yalk. ib. 42</cite>; Yalk. Chr. 1072 <he>טִימוֹסִין</he> pl.—Pl. <he>טוֹמוֹסִין</he>, <he>טוֹמוֹסוֹת</he>, <cite ref="I00083"><he>טִי׳</he></cite>. Pesik. Zakh. p. 27ᵃ [read:] <he>ונטל ט׳ וכ׳</he> (or <he>טִימוֹסָן</he>) he took the lists of the tribes &c.; Tanḥ. Ki Thetse 9.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:1:19">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵃ</cite> top <he>אף שמותיהם … טֹמְסוֹתֵיהֶם</he> even their names disappeared from their books of records.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>הוציא הנמוסין וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.; Tanḥ. Vaëra 5 <cite ref="D00976"><he>דִּפְתְּרָא</he></cite>) he brought out the lists of the deities.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>היה טימס … בעגלה</he> their census had to be carried to Jerusalem on a wagon; [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:13">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>קטמו׳</he> read <he>הטומוס</he> or <he>קִינְסוֹס</he>].
